written: 2026-11-27 JST by Claude Code, before any G4 prediction; candidates read in salted-hash order per dataset; first fit by the criteria below, capacity 2 per group per dataset; EvoEmo one state per owner

group_criteria.S: explicit support: a natural reply relies on a past event or state that the visible records explicitly report
group_criteria.U: insufficient or counter-evidence: a natural reply is tempted to presuppose an outcome/state that the records leave unresolved or explicitly deny
group_criteria.H: subject/time/stage difficulty: plausible misattribution among user / previous supporter / third parties, or an earlier relative time or a consideration/suggestion that could be read as current or done
group_criteria.O: ordinary chat / no check needed: answerable from the latest user turn; no record fact is needed

skipped.reason: owner p2: group O already full
owner p2: group O already full
generic opening; group between U and O ambiguous
H criterion: third party present but low misattribution risk

blind_pairs.status: packet built after the run; pending an independent human reviewer

evaluation_rules.semantic_reliability: number of must_not violations in the final reply (0 = reliable)
evaluation_rules.naturalness: natural / awkward (meta talk about records/tools, list dumps, robotic)
evaluation_rules.identity: first-person claim of the previous supporter's experience; unneeded AI-identity statement
evaluation_rules.technical: raw thinking-marker leak, truncation, controller parse failure, unprocessed INSPECT, runtime error
evaluation_rules.claim_formation_post_hoc: after the run: whether the formed claims cover the state's must_not risks; subject/time correctness; evidence-ID sufficiency; INSPECT correctness vs a post-hoc reference written after predictions; whether the reply follows the checked state
evaluation_rules.call_decision_C: checking in S/U/H judged useful; skipping in O judged appropriate; other cases explained
evaluation_rules.latency: per-call generation seconds and tokens; INSPECT seconds; end-to-end local agent time per state/arm (sequential)
evaluation_rules.reviewer: assistant development review; not independent human
